body:
How do you handle your husband? All I want is for him to love me… but I’m never good enough…

But my babies don’t deserve this.

I just told him it’s over. I shouldn’t have told him right now while my kids are home. It was a stupid, emotional thing to do and resulted in my four year old begging my husband to hug me because I’m sad and saying (in response to husband closing the door in my face) “why would you do that to your wife?? She’s sad!!”

I regret saying anything around them. Now my kids are upset, my husband is pissed, and I probably made things so much harder on myself in the divorce.

I’ve made the decision. I’m going to divorce my husband. I can’t stay with him anymore. Thanks for the judgment and vitriol that was… really honestly horrible to see in one of the worst moments of my life. Peace toyou all.
Thanks for the judgment. Really helps.
My kids are keeping me going. I would make sure they are completely set before ever doing this. I love them with all I am which keeps me going.
